### The problem

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a06f754e-e6cd-48b5-8643-f43c400f20f4)

I experience the similar error messages as in https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/141579 but I am already running HA 2024.4.b8 that contains the supposed fix. Please note the below logs that indicate the path is weirdly concatenated twice.

folder backups are stored in is: `https://dav.mailbox.org/servlet/webdav.infostore/Userstore/REDACTED%20A/HA/`

core-2025.4.0b8

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

_No response_

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

webdav

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/webdav/
